issues.reason: The sealed term records "he worries about it" while the text says he does not, and the instruction set states outright that a seal's missing polarity carrier "is a registered limitation, not a licence to assert the positive form".

Real that "anymore" is unrepresented, but overstated as a separate defect: cessation needs a `Past` positive and a same-symbol strength-0 denial — two truth values on one symbol — which a sealed term cannot carry, so it falls under the same missing-carrier limitation and has no licensed fix.

`Stimulus` is defined as "a psych state's object", and worry is exactly that state (its subject takes `Experiencer` on the same grounds); the prepositional-object rule bars the *direct-object* roles `Patient` / `Theme`, not the psych role, and the `About` example given ("argue about the lease") is a non-psych activity verb.

`(Even worry sk_worry_1)` asserts a focus claim at top level about an eventuality that exists only inside the seal — "nothing inside is true at top level", and only a definite referent's typing atom projects — so sealed content escapes.

gaps_confirmed: negation of a whole sealed complement — a seal has no polarity carrier, so "said that NOT P" cannot be recorded at all (registered for a negated conjunct; here it is the entire complement)
cessation ("anymore") under a seal — the past-state-plus-denial bundle needs two STVs on one symbol and is inexpressible inside a sealed term
direct quotation as a speech verb's complement — verbatim quoted speech and its first-person deixis ("I" = the quoted speaker) are nowhere addressed
new_gaps: a focus particle whose anchor eventuality lives inside a seal — the focus atom needs an eventuality in its second slot, and a sealed event is not available at top level, so the particle is lost with the sealed content
repair_summary: Dropped the whole `(Theme sk_say_1 (And …))` seal: its content is the negated proposition, a seal has no polarity carrier, and per the registered limitation nothing of it is expressible — asserting the positive form is explicitly barred, so the complement is left out rather than reversed. Removed the top-level `(Even worry sk_worry_1)`, whose anchor existed only inside that seal.
notes: The repair leaves the matrix saying (`say`, `Experiencer`, `Past`) and the antecedent-less "he"/"I" witness untouched, so the parse now records that he said something but not what — the honest outcome of the negated-seal gap. `sk_thing_1` was not re-emitted at top level, since with the complement gone nothing references it.
